summary: Revise contract: Redesign Taskboard's agent-work UI to feel substantially more polished and colorful while staying native to BB's visual language. Replace the long always-visible command/check list with an enhanced collapsible control that is collapsed by default and communicates counts, state, failures, and recent activity clearly. Add a prominent, continuously visible progress treatment for active agent work, preferably surfaced in or adjacent to the associated thread so users can understand the current phase, status, recent activity, and navigate to details without opening Taskboard. Produce and obtain approval for a focused mockup before implementation, covering wide and compact layouts and accessible color/status semantics.

state.request: Fix the Taskboard automatic-start behavior that pauses work when a build reports recoverable blockers like the supplied Roten-App result. Improve automatic work startup so blocker summaries are handled accurately and the task does not stop prematurely when actionable implementation work can continue, while preserving genuine human-decision, tracker, evidence, and policy gates.
